name: EDL Bidirectional Sync
description: Sync KiCad 9 schematics bidirectionally with EDL (Engineering Description Language) source-of-truth files.
description_full: Compile EDL projects into ERC-clean KiCad 9 schematics tagged with stable EDL_ID properties, and sync visual component moves, value edits, and footprint changes back into verified, minimal .edl source patches.
